ThingDef.label: Prima Hyperseed: Warrior
ThingDef.description:
A masterfully crafted seed that will quickly produce a specialized Terrapod. This special Terrapod is self-sustaining and designed to produce a random Prima melee weapon within a day. Knowledge on how to make hyperseeds is highly guarded, and a secret only the most devoted possess. Additionally, hyperseeds bypass normal wait times and research requirements, making them one of the only outlets of attaining Terraweapons as an Industrial+ colony. 
Hyperseeds are meant to be used shortly after acquisition, and will expire rather quickly. Be sure to not hang onto them for too long! 

Key notes: Significantly lowered growth time when compared to normal method (from ~6 full days to ~1) No research or tech level requirement No fertility requirement Will grow on any "soft" terrain (i.e. mud, dirt, and sand, but not on stone or in water)
